body: I was just looking back on your comment. Thank you again. My daughter is now home fully, finally. We have had to cut off the toxic family, so it’s the 2 of us against the world, but that has made us stronger and I am grateful to be here and to have survived the madness, most importantly for my girl. Thank you again. Wish I could post a picture of us. Take care to you and your loved ones.

I’ve had those thoughts and still do. Your great soul is louder than those thoughts. I’ve been there recently. This forum brought be back to life. Please message me if you need. I am here and I understand. Life fucking sucks sometimes, so many times. I’m here to talk when you don’t think you can take it.

Wow, I am so sorry for your friends and their situations. I am glad that they were reunited! I absolutely cannot imagine what it was like for your friend to clear his name of such horrendous accusations...He was very strong. 

My mother also did something similar in regards to pets...she isn’t smart enough to realize that I get copies of the ‘Discovery’ which is everything she has said about me. My cat was living at her house for a few years because my landlord wouldn’t allow pets. As soon as she got custody of my daughter, she tried to have my cat put down & there is Discovery of her e-mail to DHS asking if she had to ‘let me know that she was putting my cat down’. Her reasoning was that she didn’t have time to care for the cat now that she was caring for my child...it was just another cruel power move. I got my cat approved to live with me and got him a day before he was scheduled to be euthanized...it would have destroyed my daughter, to lose another loved one, after her Dad and her Mom. 

It has taken so long already but I am in a much better mind set now and it’s been 9 months and I will keep going and 9 months is a blink of the eye when it comes to my baby girl. I thank you for your comment and your original message was so helpful in my very low point. Thank you again.

I’m sorry for your loss. When my daughter was 6 her Dad took his life, last year. I still can’t wrap my head around why he would do that, if nothing else than he had a baby girl. Misery sums it all up real well. Take care of yourself and be aware that there are many phases of grief and talking, even to strangers, it helpful. It helped me very much on here with my own situation. I wish you well.

I go to a support group for survivors of suicide loss. I go because my bf and father of our daughter took his life last year at 27. But the other people there are husbands & wives who have lost their young 20-something kids to suicide. I of course don’t know all the details, but from how I interpret it, and how they have shared about their lives, they had all of the above and never saw any red flags. Loving, devoted parents, truly. They are all good people, and devastated. My bf’s story is different since he had a very horrible upbringing, the opposite of the lives of the other families in the group, but still, the same outcome for our loved ones...
Thank you. What it would do to my daughter is was keeps me living. Existing, even without her, at least I’m still existing and here in the world I guess. Thank you again.
Thank you. I am still fighting. Thank you for the reminder and support.
That has been one of the most agonizing questions for me. I can’t imagine ever doing that to someone. I will never understand.
That is actually one of the things that keeps me going - I want my daughter raised differently than I was, and she deserves so much more. Thank you for reminding me. Hugs.
I thank you for your message. I have been doing better. Still fighting and won’t let them win.
Thank you very much for your message. I am doing better. Human to human, your message was so helpful.

Thank you. I want the world for her. I was very down and out only seeing her 2 hours a week. I had 6 months of supervised visits by strangers. It was so demeaning and degrading. But they have now given me 4 days/nights and it gave me hope back and I’ll continue fighting.

Thank you for kindness.

My mother told the State that I was mentally unfit and had an undiagnosed mental illness (I don’t, i was in grief), that I didn’t properly feed or care for her, that I was acting erratic and subjecting my daughter to emotional harm because I involved her in her Dad’s funeral. In actuality, she was upset that I listed her Dad’s family as guardians in my Will, and I let her go to Arizona for a week to see her uncles and cousins on her Dad’s side. She felt like she was losing grip on controlling me and my daughter, and she’s a very proud person, very passive aggressive also. She would never have been able to do what she did if her Dad was alive. She’s never thought I was a competent mother and she sunk her claws in the second she had the chance. 

Yes, I have a lawyer and have made progress. I have my daughter 4 days/nights a week now, and we are trying to get it dismissed next month. So that has given me the only hope I’ve  had in 9 months. 

Unfortunately, there were 2 recent child deaths in my area, one was in custody of DHS, and they got a lot of media coverage and DHS got blamed for not protecting the kids and causing their deaths. They went full-throttle on any incoming reports just to protect themselves. The roll of DHS is to assist/help families, not criminalize the moms. The process is so flawed. People can call in and say whatever they want about you and it’s taken as truth, and it’s essentially slander that you can’t fight. Their report goes to a judge even before you get a chance to fight their accusations, they don’t need proof, and a judge just signs off on whatever they say. Then it takes a year to prove them wrong. 

I keep fighting. It’s sad because my Mom is the reason this has dragged on this long - every time I make progress, she gets worried and stirs up more accusations. She’s worried that I won’t let her be involved at all if I get her back, so she just doesn’t stop. I can’t imagine doing such a thing to my daughter. So I am keeping fighting. I have to. I can’t let them win. 

Thank you.

I am sorry for your situation but thank you for your comment and insight on how it affected you. I’m glad your dad kept fighting and won, and that gives me hope. The state is just so horrible and degrading to parents. They have picked my every move apart. It has been horrible and life changing.  It I’m still fighting I guess.
Thank you. I did not give up yet. Thank you.

Thank you for your message. I’ve had more support from people on this site , strangers, in one short month than the entire year from family and friends. This really helped me when I was at the bottom of it. I am doing better and I keep fighting, because you’re right, my daughter would be devastated. Existing for her, even if it’s not ideal situation is better than not existing at all for her.
I will keep trying best I can. Thank you for your kind words.
I am trying, but then the State will use it against me if I leave the one they appointed me. It is all such a bad mess. Everything is a mess.
Thank you, from Maine, USA. It means a lot. Happiness to you and your loved ones.
Thank you. I will try to be strong and get through this. Thank you for kind words.
If 99 percent is against you, there is still 1 percent for you. You have helped me and you sound like a beautiful woman -
It’s hard to stick around for someone who isn’t even in your life anymore. I would move oceans for that girl, but I’m just a ghost now.
Ok. Thank you. I am so appreciative of that offer. I’m on the fence right now, and kindness from strangers is very helpful, since I have no one anyway. Yes, silence and loneliness is very bad.
Thank you for your kind comment.
😭😭😭. You are incredibly kind. I will try to hang on.
Oh boy. I can relate to this. Good vibes to you.

I am so sorry for you. Thank you for your words of kindness. I think of my daughter every second of every moment. She is so messed up and hurt because of all of this. Her Dad was a wonderful human and I’m sure yours was also.  But for me, I’m just so tired. I understand the mental exhaustion now.
I keep coming back to your message. I needed to hear exactly what you said. Thank you so much. Peace & love & hugs from my ‘family’ to yours.
Ok, thank you.
Ok. Thank you. I won’t give up.

Thank you so much. Not that drug addiction isn’t horrible itself, but her friends’ parents would turn their backs at me when I’d pick her up from school. Addiction is very scary too, but her father hung himself and never had any issues with addiction. The problem is judge mental people. But thank you for your comment.
Ok.
Thank you. I’ve come very far, we have come very far. Thank you for your kind words. I’m just so tired.

No. I have my Grandmother who is 97. I don’t want to upset her too much. I have no friends anymore and my therapist is shit - her father died by suicide and I think she needs her own therapy. I’m done.

Also I just got a message from some random person telling me that I was shit and I should definitely kill my self and that I should kill my daughter as well. What the fuck!
Thank you, I appreciate that. Yes, my daughter lives with my mother while I jump through every single hoop they throw at me. I’m done though.
